Davidson’s Symetra Tour event postponed

By art@lakenormanpublications.com
on April 02, 2020

FacebookTwitterEmailMessengerCopy LinkMessageShare

Amanda Sambach’s caddie, left, laughs at a comment by Perrine Dalacour at the end of the round in 2019. Doug Coats

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:56
Instaread

The Symetra Classic was one of several tournaments on the “Road to the LPGA” postponed during the COVID-19 outbreak.

It was scheduled to be hosted by Davidson’s River Run Country Club for the third straight year as part of the Symetra Tour, a women’s professional tour one step below the LPGA.

The Symetra is one of five tour postponed, as two – The IOA Championship and Four Winds Invitational – already have been rescheduled for late July and August.

The last two years, Davidson teen Amanda Sambach has competed on her home course, finished 11th a year ago as an amateur among professionals.

Leona MaGuire, who played collegiately at Duke, won the 2019 tournament at 10-under.

The Symetra Tour team is in consistent communication with tournament title sponsors and the venues to find suitable weeks in the latter part of the season to reschedule postponed events. More information will be shared as plans are finalized.
